description: Per-family host fixtures for the Latin families (FF-41, FF-43). A family appears under a host only when that host's fixture passed for it: the route face resolved for each of the four styles (no unintended fallback), the face's own advances within 0.1 px, the files fetched or served matched what the deck draws, and, where a host draws, the faces painted as themselves. The gallery editor entry covers the files its committed manifest serves; the editor's gate code is the vendored opf-editor bundle, exercised by the editor entry.

source.runtime: Node v26.4.0, renderer 0.11.9, the editor's createFontGate
